author: DJI
description:
DJI Avata 360 is DJI’s first panoramic drone, redefining flight possibilities with flagship-level panoramic imaging. 
Capture limitless creative shots in a single take with 8K/60fps HDR video. Switch freely between 360° panoramic and single-lens shooting modes. Paired with O4+ full-HD video transmission, Avata 360 unlocks new horizons for creative aerial panorama.
